verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. The pack documents no export feature or open-format download, only adjacent items: open-source self-hosting, MCP read tools such as getting threads, and a contributor-only Drizzle Studio for viewing database data. None of these is a first-party export-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
